name: The Good News According to Matthew

verses.text: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,
saying, “\+w The \+w scribes \+w and \+w the \+w Pharisees \+w sit \+w on \+w Moses \+w seat *

\+w All \+w things \+w therefore \+w whatever \+w they \+w tell \+w you \+w to \+w observe \+w observe \+w and \+w do \+w but don’\+w t \+w do \+w their \+w works \+w for \+w they \+w say \+w and don’\+w t \+w do *

\+w For \+w they \+w bind heavy \+w burdens \+w that \+w are grievous \+w to \+w be borne, \+w and \+w lay \+w them \+w on \+w men \+w shoulders \+w but \+w they themselves \+w will \+w not lift \+w a \+w finger \+w to help \+w them *

\+w But \+w they \+w do \+w all \+w their \+w works \+w to \+w be \+w seen \+w by \+w men \+w They \+w make \+w their \+w phylacteries broad \+w and \+w enlarge \+w the fringes* \+w of \+w their garments, *
\+w and \+w love \+w the \+w place \+w of \+w honor \+w at \+w feasts \+w the best \+w seats \+w in \+w the \+w synagogues *
\+w the salutations \+w in \+w the marketplaces, \+w and \+w to \+w be \+w called ‘\+w Rabbi \+w Rabbi \+w by \+w men *
\+w But \+w you \+w are \+w not \+w to \+w be \+w called ‘\+w Rabbi \+w for \+w one \+w is \+w your \+w teacher \+w the \+w Christ \+w and \+w all \+w of \+w you \+w are brothers. *
\+w Call \+w no \+w man \+w on \+w the \+w earth \+w your \+w father \+w for \+w one \+w is \+w your \+w Father \+w he \+w who \+w is \+w in \+w heaven *
\+w Neither \+w be \+w called \+w masters \+w for \+w one \+w is \+w your \+w master \+w the \+w Christ *
\+w But \+w he \+w who \+w is \+w greatest \+w among \+w you \+w will \+w be \+w your \+w servant *
\+w Whoever \+w exalts \+w himself \+w will \+w be \+w humbled \+w and \+w whoever \+w humbles \+w himself \+w will \+w be \+w exalted

“\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w scribes \+w and \+w Pharisees \+w hypocrites \+w For \+w you devour widows’ houses, \+w and \+w as \+w a pretense \+w you \+w make \+w long prayers. \+w Therefore \+w you \+w will receive \+w greater condemnation.*
“But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.*

\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w scribes \+w and \+w Pharisees \+w hypocrites \+w For \+w you \+w travel \+w around \+w by \+w sea \+w and \+w land \+w to \+w make \+w one \+w proselyte \+w and \+w when \+w he \+w becomes \+w one \+w you \+w make \+w him \+w twice \+w as \+w much \+w a \+w son \+w of Gehenna* \+w as \+w yourselves *

“\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w you \+w blind \+w guides \+w who \+w say ‘\+w Whoever \+w swears \+w by \+w the \+w temple \+w it \+w is \+w nothing \+w but \+w whoever \+w swears \+w by \+w the \+w gold \+w of \+w the \+w temple \+w he \+w is \+w obligated *
\+w You \+w blind \+w fools \+w For \+w which \+w is \+w greater \+w the \+w gold \+w or \+w the \+w temple \+w that sanctifies \+w the \+w gold *
\+w And ‘\+w Whoever \+w swears \+w by \+w the \+w altar \+w it \+w is \+w nothing \+w but \+w whoever \+w swears \+w by \+w the \+w gift \+w that \+w is \+w on \+w it \+w he \+w is \+w obligated *
\+w You \+w blind fools! \+w For \+w which \+w is \+w greater \+w the \+w gift \+w or \+w the \+w altar \+w that sanctifies \+w the \+w gift *
\+w He \+w therefore \+w who \+w swears \+w by \+w the \+w altar \+w swears \+w by \+w it \+w and \+w by \+w everything \+w on \+w it *
\+w He \+w who \+w swears \+w by \+w the \+w temple \+w swears \+w by \+w it \+w and \+w by \+w him \+w who \+w has \+w been \+w living \+w in \+w it *
\+w He \+w who \+w swears \+w by \+w heaven \+w swears \+w by \+w the \+w throne \+w of \+w God \+w and \+w by \+w him \+w who \+w sits \+w on \+w it

“\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w scribes \+w and \+w Pharisees \+w hypocrites \+w For \+w you tithe \+w mint dill, \+w and cumin,* \+w and \+w have \+w left undone \+w the weightier matters \+w of \+w the \+w law \+w justice \+w mercy \+w and \+w faith \+w But \+w you \+w ought \+w to \+w have \+w done \+w these \+w and \+w not \+w to \+w have \+w left \+w the \+w other undone. *
\+w You \+w blind \+w guides \+w who \+w strain out \+w a \+w gnat \+w and \+w swallow \+w a \+w camel *

“\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w scribes \+w and \+w Pharisees \+w hypocrites \+w For \+w you \+w clean \+w the \+w outside \+w of \+w the \+w cup \+w and \+w of \+w the \+w platter \+w but \+w within \+w they \+w are \+w full \+w of extortion \+w and unrighteousness.*
\+w You \+w blind \+w Pharisee \+w first \+w clean \+w the \+w inside \+w of \+w the \+w cup \+w and \+w of \+w the \+w platter \+w that its \+w outside \+w may \+w become \+w clean \+w also

“\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w scribes \+w and \+w Pharisees \+w hypocrites \+w For \+w you \+w are \+w like whitened \+w tombs \+w which \+w outwardly \+w appear \+w beautiful \+w but \+w inwardly \+w are \+w full \+w of \+w dead \+w men \+w bones \+w and \+w of \+w all uncleanness. *
\+w Even \+w so \+w you \+w also \+w outwardly \+w appear \+w righteous \+w to \+w men \+w but \+w inwardly \+w you \+w are \+w full \+w of \+w hypocrisy \+w and iniquity.*

“\+w Woe \+w to \+w you \+w scribes \+w and \+w Pharisees \+w hypocrites \+w For \+w you \+w build \+w the \+w tombs \+w of \+w the \+w prophets \+w and \+w decorate \+w the \+w tombs \+w of \+w the \+w righteous *

\+w and \+w say ‘\+w If \+w we \+w had \+w lived \+w in \+w the \+w days \+w of \+w our \+w fathers \+w we wouldn’\+w t \+w have \+w been \+w partakers \+w with \+w them \+w in \+w the blood \+w of \+w the \+w prophets *
\+w Therefore \+w you \+w testify \+w to \+w yourselves \+w that \+w you \+w are \+w children \+w of \+w those \+w who \+w killed \+w the \+w prophets *
\+w Fill \+w up \+w then \+w the \+w measure \+w of \+w your \+w fathers *
\+w You \+w serpents \+w you \+w offspring \+w of \+w vipers \+w how \+w will \+w you \+w escape \+w the \+w judgment \+w of Gehenna?*

\+w Therefore \+w behold \+w I send \+w to \+w you \+w prophets \+w wise \+w men \+w and \+w scribes \+w Some \+w of \+w them \+w you \+w will kill \+w and \+w crucify \+w and \+w some \+w of \+w them \+w you \+w will \+w scourge \+w in \+w your \+w synagogues \+w and \+w persecute \+w from \+w city \+w to \+w city *

\+w that \+w on \+w you \+w may \+w come \+w all \+w the \+w righteous blood \+w shed \+w on \+w the \+w earth \+w from \+w the blood \+w of \+w righteous Abel \+w to \+w the blood \+w of Zachariah \+w son \+w of Barachiah, \+w whom \+w you \+w killed \+w between \+w the \+w sanctuary \+w and \+w the \+w altar *
Most \+w certainly \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w all \+w these \+w things \+w will \+w come \+w upon \+w this \+w generation

“\+w Jerusalem \+w Jerusalem \+w who kills \+w the \+w prophets \+w and \+w stones \+w those \+w who \+w are \+w sent \+w to \+w her \+w How \+w often \+w I \+w would \+w have \+w gathered \+w your \+w children \+w together \+w even \+w as \+w a \+w hen \+w gathers \+w her \+w chicks \+w under \+w her \+w wings \+w and \+w you \+w would \+w not *
\+w Behold \+w your \+w house \+w is left \+w to \+w you \+w desolate *

\+w For \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w you \+w will \+w not \+w see \+w me \+w from \+w now \+w on \+w until \+w you \+w say ‘\+w Blessed \+w is \+w he \+w who \+w comes \+w in \+w the \+w name \+w of \+w the \+w Lord
